claim: To increase read and write capacity, you can scale up an ElastiCache (Redis OSS) cluster by selecting a larger node type, or reduce capacity by selecting a smaller node. You can also scale out read capacity by adding read replicas and write capacity by adding a specified number of new shards to a cluster.

qualifiers.scope: node-based ElastiCache (Redis OSS) clusters, as described in the Redis caching whitepaper (historical reference)

evidence.quote: To increase read and write capacity, you can scale up your cluster by selecting a larger node type, and alternatively read and write capacity can be reduced by selecting a smaller node.
You can also scale out read capacity by adding read replicas and write capacity by adding a specified number of new shards to a cluster.

note: The whitepaper carries the banner: for historical reference only. It names ElastiCache (Redis OSS), not Valkey.
